name: UPI — Unified Payments Interface
description: UPI is the world's largest real-time payments system by volume (10B+ transactions monthly as of 2024). Account-to-account instant transfers using virtual payment addresses (VPAs); core to India Stack.

license.notes: Technical API specs partly public; participant security rules and operational guidelines members-only via NPCI participation agreements. Public-release government / central bank publication (Tier 1 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: public government website content goes into the public dataset repository regardless of license).

lifecycle.notes: When CSA acquires a licensed copy, promote into a versioned subdir.
